edc44d164592709666fb77ae56d99645eaadf1c9.sourceText: 启用续建时选择map_start_pose，或选择map_start_at_dock=True。两者都给时pose优先；pose数量不是3时，源码报错后采用`[0,0,0]`，并不会因此自动改用dock。只将dock设为False也不等于关闭旧图加载，关闭加载的入口是空map_file_name。[起点选择与加载逻辑（2.6.10）](https://github.com/SteveMacenski/slam_toolbox/blob/2.6.10/src/slam_toolbox_common.cpp)
edc44d164592709666fb77ae56d99645eaadf1c9.translatedText: When enabling resume construction, select map_start_pose, or set map_start_at_dock=True\. If both are provided, pose takes priority; when the number of poses is not 3, the source code reports an error and then uses`[0,0,0]`and will not automatically switch to dock because of this\. Setting only dock to False also does not mean disabling old map loading; the entry point for disabling loading is an empty map_file_name\.[Starting point selection and loading logic (2\.6\.10)](https://github.com/SteveMacenski/slam_toolbox/blob/2.6.10/src/slam_toolbox_common.cpp)
